# prime-tabs

prime-rs: Tabs component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/tabs) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-tabs) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/tabs.md)

Tabs: port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-tabs`, `p-tablist`, `p-tab`, `p-tabpanels`, `p-tabpanel`.

A compound component of five parts, as in PrimeNG: `Tabs` holds the active value, `TabList` contains the tabs,
the indicator bar and scroll buttons, `Tab` is a tab, `TabPanels` and `TabPanel` are the panels. A tab and a panel are linked
by the same `value`; the parts communicate through the Leptos context.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_tabs::{Tab, TabList, TabPanel, TabPanels, Tabs};

let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! {
    <Tabs default_value="1">
        <TabList>
            <Tab value="0">"Header I"</Tab>
            <Tab value="1">"Header II"</Tab>
        </TabList>
        <TabPanels>
            <TabPanel value="0"><p>"Content I"</p></TabPanel>
            <TabPanel value="1"><p>"Content II"</p></TabPanel>
        </TabPanels>
    </Tabs>
}
.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-tab-active") && html.contains(r#"aria-selected="true""#) && html.contains("Content II"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-tabs = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["tabs"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
